region: TTR and modern type theories: scoped comparisons
summary: Explicit A/F models for the TTR fragment. Proves type identity differs from coextension, truth erasure loses witness assignments, inhabited ptypes need not have an inhabited meet, and structured-witness relabelling needs model compatibility.

sources.citation: Cooper, R. (2023). From Perception to Communication. OUP.

definitions_mapped.note: Separate basic and ptype extensions; monomorphic basic arity checks and atom coverage.
Fixed syntax and chosen model family; not the varying Type_M formation discipline.

theorems.name: Countermodels.same_type_same_object_different_models / Countermodels.erased_assignments_agree
theorems.source_claim: Assignment changes are invisible to the erased ptype truth values.

theorems.name: Countermodels.coextension_does_not_identify_types
theorems.source_claim: Distinct type codes may have the same extension.

theorems.name: Countermodels.inhabited_conjuncts_empty_meet
theorems.source_claim: Meet requires the same witness, not just separate inhabitation.

theorems.name: Countermodels.structured_witness_renaming_needs_model_compatibility
theorems.source_claim: Arbitrary F can distinguish relabelled record witnesses.

evidence: Assessment limited to the explicitly stated fragment; see audits/ttr_comparison.md. Mechanical results are stored separately in the .mech.json sidecar.
simplifications: Fixed type syntax; no full A9 varying type domains or A10 stratification.
omissions: Fixed type syntax; no full A9 varying type domains or A10 stratification.
additions: countermodels and a computable structural subtyping approximation

determination_rationale: The stated restricted core is reconstructed with explicit representation choices. This is not an assessment that the full book transfers unchanged.

artifact_classes.description: Explicit deep type codes, assignments and list-based records or comparison maps; Coq is the metalanguage.

notes: Source-based implementation audit on 2026-09-12; no independent second semantic reviewer is claimed. See audits/ttr_comparison.md for limitations and references.
